chunks: And ʿAlī ibn Abī Ḥamzah narrated from Abū al-Ḥasan عليه السلام:

He was asked about a man who forgot to perform tawaf of the House until he returned to his family, so he said: "If it was on account of ignorance, he must repeat the hajj and a camel is due from him."

key_terms.الْجَهَالَةِ: ignorance, lacking knowledge of the ruling or obligation
key_terms.بَدَنَةٌ: a camel to be offered as sacrificial compensation
key_terms.يَطُوفَ: to perform tawaf, the circumambulation of the Kaʿbah

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if someone returns home without performing tawaf in hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about one who failed to perform tawaf and only realized after returning home. It states that if the omission occurred in a state of ignorance, he must repeat the hajj and offer a camel as compensation.
